cycles.title: Policy-0T dispatcher/core proof-system separation
cycles.result: The full Policy-0T ordinary-Resolution simulation was destroyed by its polynomial affine/Gaussian shortcut on Resolution-hard expander-Tseitin formulas. The route was repaired by separating the affine_answer=None search core from the parity-aware dispatcher. A recursive finite translator now reconstructs a root Resolution proof from the verified non-affine trace.
cycles.claim_boundary: C021 does not prove the universal H132 induction, emit the H133 Res(⊕) affine certificate, establish the MAJ3 asymptotic lower bound, or resolve P versus NP.
